title: Atlas Launch Timeline
body_markdown:
Project Atlas runs in four phases, led by Joe Smith.
1. **Planning** — October to December 2026: budget approval, hub lease, hiring plan
2. **Build-out** — January to February 2027: fit out the Lisbon hub, onboard vehicles
3. **Soft launch** — March 2027: first five customers, daily review of delivery performance
4. **Scale** — April to September 2027: grow to 15 regional retail customers
A go or no-go checkpoint happens at the end of February 2027.
